facts.text: Founded in 1867 by nine freedmen known as the Marion Nine, the school opened as Lincoln Normal School and is one of the oldest HBCUs and the first in Alabama.

sources.title: History & Traditions | Alabama State University
sources.quote: Constructed on this location, the Lincoln Normal School opened on Nov. 13, 1867, with 113 students — a distinction that makes us one of the oldest HBCUs and the first in Alabama.
